This '''Mandalorian''' was part of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] terrorist organization and was stationed in a [[Death Watch camp|camp]] on the snow-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
After junior [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] along with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to deliver a [[Holotrace device/Legends|Holotrace device]] with the location of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] terrorist organization known as [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], the three found themselves surrounded by a squadron of Death Watch troopers under command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze/Legends|Bo-Katan Kryze]].

After a debate regarding Ahsoka's identity, Bo-Katan told everybody that they needed to leave the area because a snow storm was coming. Tano was reluctant to leave and suggested that she stay with the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], but this trooper insisted that she come as well. The Death Watch members then escorted Bonteri, Tano and Artoo to their campsite.
